sample_unit: LLM answers rated by surgeons (24 questions x 5 models)

links.outcome: Readability of LLM answers on laparoscopic cholecystectomy (FRES, FKGL)
links.effect: DeepSeek was most readable (FRES ≈ 30.6; FKGL ≈ 12.1); Claude was densest (negative FRES; FKGL ≈ 18.3). All models were above plain-language reading levels.
links.quote: DeepSeek produced the most readable output (FRES ≈ 30.6; FKGL ≈ 12.1), while Claude generated the densest, least readable text (negative FRES; FKGL ≈ 18.3).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the performance, readability, and quality of five LLMs answering guideline-derived questions on laparoscopic cholecystectomy using expert surgeon raters, without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
